text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, I have something to discuss. 
Though I imagine you might already know—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The latest volume of "Traces of the 
Tiara," a compilation of Triple Tiara race 
footage, is coming out!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's, well, um... quite expensive, but... 
Still, still! I'm sure it'll be useful 
reference material for you too, Trainer! 
So—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-If you're planning on buying it... could 
you lend it to me afterward? My allowance 
isn't nearly enough to afford it~...!
